messages.content: Independent final enterprise predeployment rubric for exact SHA 9e4b5089dec3ab4619ae15964d1900db60bf76f7. P means PASS and F means FAIL. Mark F only for a concrete unresolved material defect demonstrated by the supplied implementation evidence. External creation of a real Google OAuth client is a separately gated deployment setup step, not a code defect when the app fails closed and reports unavailable until configured. Output schema JSON only.

Evaluate exact V10 SHA 9e4b5089dec3ab4619ae15964d1900db60bf76f7 using the evidence below.

architecture: existing tenant/RBAC and Graph execution kernel retained; V10 adds invitation membership, external Google identity, simple Team UX and role labels without replacing product authority. Google only proves identity; Media Factory decides tenant and role. Host /me session contract remains shared by local and Google users.
security_privacy: confidential code flow, PKCE S256, state, nonce, browser-flow binding cookie, JWKS RS256 verification, iss/aud/azp/exp/iat/nonce/email_verified checks, Google-authoritative Gmail/Workspace email, stable sub identity. Client secret AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest with authenticated AAD in a private vault, secret write-only to UI, key file owner/mode checks. No Google access/refresh token persisted. Local break-glass remains.
supply_chain: no new npm dependency; package.json and pnpm lock unchanged; Node built-ins only for crypto/JWT verification; production audit clean.
agent_tool_governance: team membership changes require authenticated tenant owner/admin; Google credential changes require configured system administrator; coordinators cannot administer users; human stage permissions are explicit and the execution kernel independently enforces producer/reviewer separation and critic/verifier separation; no automatic publish or paid provider authority added.
state_concurrency: AtomicRepository remains authoritative; pending invitations and acceptance are transaction-bound; OAuth state is server-persisted, one-time, expiry-limited and capped; browser-flow token is separately hashed; configuration hash binds each OAuth flow to the exact credential version; sessions are server-persisted and expiry-bound.
evidence_release_integrity: exact clean SHA 9e4b5089dec3ab4619ae15964d1900db60bf76f7; browser runtime 1481 files, zero forbidden entries, zero external symlinks; manifest c274a705574e6b1b57ce56e9821fef2ee312cfa4dedd93e0b28f8b709f20a9d6; production-source 3ae64d16de211eb2402a02ae0eb423c1cd238b9b6b4b907484724c706806731d; exact FIRMES non-test completion preserves artifact/review integrity.
fail_closed_behavior: missing Google config hides sign-in; malformed/expired/replayed/wrong-browser OAuth state fails; config rotation invalidates inflight flow; invalid JWKS/signature/claims/email fails; uninvited identity fails; tenant mismatch fails; corrupted vault ciphertext fails and cannot be silently overwritten; owner cannot be removed/demoted; coordinators cannot release; IT cannot Critic; local break-glass stays available.
testing: 211 discovered / 210 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; focused exact 57/57; typecheck/build/contracts 13/13/audit PASS; exact browser E2E PASS; exact non-test FIRMES completion PASS; detached exact focused verifier 40/40 plus typecheck/contracts/audit PASS. Coverage includes encrypted credential restart persistence, corruption, system-admin authority, login CSRF binding, replay, identity claims, tenant isolation, owner/admin team management and stage-specific approvals.
operations_recovery: Google configuration lives in persistent product data rather than ephemeral deploy env; local owner credential remains break-glass; config may be replaced/removed by authorized system admin; OAuth flow is one-time and restart-safe while state remains in repository; existing host forward-auth consumes the same /me session.
portability: Node crypto/fetch and existing Next/React stack only; optional env bootstrap retained; no Google SDK or hosting-specific auth dependency.

Known separate setup: a real Google Web OAuth client has not been supplied. Production should remain Google-unavailable until the owner saves Client ID/Secret and registers https://media-factory.textilesdemedellin.com/api/v1/auth/google/callback. Do not treat that external setup as a code defect.
